Clean. I found no blocking defect in the full diff.

I checked the current upstream laws and both threads. This review uses the explicit permission to review this contributor's draft. The draft state, labels and title stay unchanged.

The new profile states the Z1 Pro limits and uses the shared Carvera post. The native file table and the embedded file table both include it. The tests cover both models, Air M7/M9 output, travel refusal and spindle refusal. The figures agree with [Makera's public specifications](https://global.makera.com/products/makera-z1-desktop-cnc).

Local results use a clean trial merge with upstream/main `3c7cbe86056cdf306c7bfa6909bc7d5d94088542`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 20 steps passed; 0 failed; 0 stalled. The site step was skipped because Node is missing. This is a tool skip under the gate rules, not a pass.
- Quick build steps passed for post and app. Post suites: `post_engine` 143 passed; `script_cycles` 122 passed. App library: 329 passed.
- Catalog suites: `example_catalog` 50 passed, 4 ignored; `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed; `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed; `catalog_groove_part_off` 1 passed.
- Other quick suites passed: `continuous_4axis_part` 10; `default_machine_missing` 10; `docs_troubleshooting` 5; `first_4axis_part` 4; `first_part_programs` 2; `first_router_part` 4; `makera_z1` 4; `probe_no_coolant` 5; `shipped_from_disk` 3; `tilt_basis_compat` 7; the changed `machine` test 1.
- Extra suites run: full `machine` 61 passed; `machine_library` 17 passed; `posting` 17 passed. No fixture directory or importer changed, so the extra fixture and STEP rules do not apply.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety checks used two temporary runtime copies of the new machine file. No tracked code changed:

1. Set the Pro X feed limit to 1200 instead of 2000. The figures test failed at `crates/app/tests/makera_z1.rs:78`. Restore the file: the test passed.
2. Set the Pro spindle limit to 20000 instead of 13000. The named spindle-refusal test failed at `crates/app/tests/makera_z1.rs:123`. Restore the file: the test passed.

The copies were removed. The full restored `makera_z1` suite passed all 4 tests. Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no recorded NC or CL program. It changes no UI file, dependency, build script or workflow.

- Light lane: all 11 tests passed across `motion light: lib`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_island`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck`, `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`, and `app light: pocket_pass_start`; 0 failed; 0 stalled. All five test steps ran in release mode. The blanket build step was not needed. No full heavy lane ran.
- CLI smoke: `cargo run -p camcraft-post --bin post -- --machine assets/machines/makera-z1-pro.mch assets/posts/carvera.cps crates/post/tests/klartext/contour.cnc /tmp/review-4435-contour-smoke.nc` passed with no warnings (18 lines, 15 mapped records, 0 swallowed). An earlier smoke with `recorded/streams/tool_change.cnc` completed with 3 warnings for its thread hand and flood requests; it is not a clean Air milling fixture. The Makera tests check Air output for both models without warnings.

Findings: none. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please mark this draft ready with `gh pr ready 4435 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
